stem: During a developmental review, which behaviour best fits the restricted behaviours, interests and activities domain of autism spectrum disorder (ASD)?
explanation: Spinning and fixation on detail best fit the restricted behaviours, interests and activities domain of ASD. This domain includes repetitive movements and unusually intense or narrow interests.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Community/Developmental - Autism Spectrum Disorder

optionExplanations.A: Incorrect because no response to name is a social communication concern rather than a restricted behaviour.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because no sharing of enjoyment reflects impaired social reciprocity, not restricted behaviours.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because echolalia is a communication feature rather than a restricted behaviour.
optionExplanations.D: Correct because spinning and fixation on detail are classic restricted behaviours, interests and activities seen in ASD.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because poor eye contact is a social interaction feature, not a restricted behaviour.
